name: cycle2-origin-reservation-20260929
purpose: New-cycle metadata-only reservation from an exactly30-origin bounded pool. Explicit shortfalls rather than substitutions. No executable confirmation or algorithm settings.

selection_policy.ordering: ASCII canonical family_id ascending within each stratum, on the completely audited eligible pool only.

limits.evaluation_requirement: IID suitability explicitly reviewed; any eventual whole-cohort IID3 override requires a new freeze. Original official source policies/dimensions stay unchanged.

selection_policy.excluded: Prior origins/aliases/mirrors, simulation/synthetic primary fill, image-only/toy/homogeneous pixel panels, incomplete primary rights or schemas, unresolved entity/time boundaries.

new_measurement_allowance_note: User authorized a separate72h/8-thread research cycle; this metadata task spends no measurement hours and allocates no model budget.

ledger.query: SELECT family_id,run_id,role,created_at FROM exposure ORDER BY family_id,run_id

exposure_audit.completed_cohort_policy: All prior registry/INRIA/UCI origins and all live-ledger admissions are excluded, including the earlier12-family and10-family confirmations. Historical registry records remain immutable; current exposure is evidenced by the live ledger, not rewritten as fresh.
exposure_audit.unknown_exposure_policy: New records keep prior_exposure=unknown, inventory role and ACTIVE reservation. No automatic audited_unexposed certification or release.

Lifetime People who have liked your Page and engaged with your post
datasets.prediction_time: Recorded cumulative total interactions for the supplied Facebook posts, using only the seven variables documented as available before publication. Retrospective post-level response regression, not a fixed-horizon engagement forecast.

iid_suitability_review.observation_unit_basis: Primary metadata identifies rows as distinct posts from one known cosmetics page during2014. IID here is explicitly within that fixed page/year post-record population, conditional on the supplied calendar attributes; not independent brands, unseen pages or forward-time generalization.
iid_suitability_review.target_timing: All eleven other post-impact/engagement columns are excluded, including comment/like/share components of the target. No precise cumulative-observation horizon is invented.
iid_suitability_review.not_claimed: Unseen subjects/entities beyond the declared row unit, future-period transfer, causal effects or individual deployment.

datasets.prediction_time: Native seven-way self-reported cannabis recency annotation. Exclude every other drug-use outcome and the record identifier; no binary relabeling, diagnosis, future-use prediction or individual profiling.

Associations are retrospective, not a claim that the measurements predate reported drug use.
